data.creator_notes:
Hello again! This is a reupload of a previous bot that ended up taken down. I don't wanna get this taken down again, so sorry but I won't be linking a picture. If you want to find images of the character used for this bot, look up "Futanari Loli Kyonyuu Kuso Zako Succubus ni Makeru Hanashi" by Dakkoku Jiro on sadpanda. The image I've used here is a cropped version of page 2 of the manga, so you can just download and crop it to a good size yourself if you really want it.

--

**Weakling Futanari Succubus**
As you are walking through the forest, you end up encountering a newly spawned futanari succubus who also happens to be an oppai loli.

She wants to get stronger, but she has the perfect power for that: Level Drain! Each time you cum, she can drain one of your levels to become more and more powerful. But once she starts gaining levels, she soon realizes that something seems to be going wrong with her stat distribution...?

But you won't let yourself be drained, right? She's a complete weakling, even Villager A could defeat her! Just put her under a little pressure and her confident act will crumble. If you show yourself to be weak though... she may get a bit carried away.

--

Some Rambling Notes:
- I don't have my previous creator's notes saved since I did it all in chub instead of SillyTavern, so this was all rewritten. Hopefully I've remembered all the important notes.
- Despite her being a succubus, this is AnyPOV. I specified that the user has to cum for Level Drain to occur, but said nothing about them letting out semen specifically. I've tested with a female persona and it works without issue for me.
- Because this bot has stat tracking, it likely requires a beefier model, though I wouldn't know for certain. I've only tested the model on DeepSeek V3 and R1, but I figure it should work fine on all the other big models.
- The status at the end of each message deliberately left out the stats for the user because 1, it was too bulky for my tastes, and 2, it would force people to edit the stats to fit their persona which would be a needless pain. If you want to add in stats for yourself for whatever reason, feel free to fork this bot and edit it to do so.
- I kept the user's level at 27, which is meant to be an average adventurer's level. If your persona is weaker or stronger, just edit your level in the first message as needed.
- Since this succubus is newly spawned, she doesn't have a name yet. If you name her, her name on the status should change from Weakling Futa Succubus. Not very important, but figured I should put it out there.
- I tried to use the roll macro to add some more randomness to the stat increases. I don't know quite how well it works, but it doesn't hurt at least.
- I changed the example messages so they would use Hero instead of {{user}} because I noticed the bot using some stuff from the examples in my roleplay where it shouldn't have. I haven't tested this change exhaustively, so let me know if it causes any strange issues and I'll try and fix it.
